Margin Notes — The discovery fieldbook

The original prompt, shown as plain text. Select the text to copy it.

Prompt

Create a content upgrade landing page:

1. HERO SECTION
Compelling introduction:
- Headline with benefit
- Content type + title
- Preview image (cover/mockup)
- Brief description
- Primary CTA button

2. CONTENT PREVIEW
Visual representation:
- 3D book/document mockup
- Page previews
- Table of contents glimpse
- Infographic preview
- Video walkthrough

3. WHAT'S INSIDE
Detailed breakdown:
- Chapter/section list
- Key topics covered
- Number of pages/length
- Included templates
- Bonus materials

4. WHO IT'S FOR
Target audience:
- "This is for you if..."
- Job titles/roles
- Experience levels
- Pain points addressed
- Goals aligned

5. KEY TAKEAWAYS
Bullet point value:
- "You'll learn how to..."
- Specific skills gained
- Problems solved
- Outcomes achieved
- Actionable insights

6. AUTHOR CREDIBILITY
Build trust:
- Author photo
- Bio and credentials
- Company/brand
- Previous work
- Industry recognition

7. SOCIAL PROOF
Validation:
- Download count
- Reader testimonials
- Star ratings
- Company logos
- Media mentions

8. SAMPLE CONTENT
Give a taste:
- One page preview
- Key stat or insight
- Memorable quote
- Mini excerpt
- Teaser infographic

9. EMAIL CAPTURE FORM
Simple collection:
- Name (optional)
- Email (required)
- Company (optional)
- "Download Now" button
- Privacy assurance

10. OBJECTION HANDLING
Address concerns:
- Is it really free?
- What format is it?
- Will I be spammed?
- How long is it?
- When do I get it?

11. URGENCY ELEMENTS
Optional motivation:
- Limited availability
- Version updates coming
- Exclusive content
- Early access benefits

12. MOBILE EXPERIENCE
Responsive design:
- Readable on all devices
- Easy form completion
- Quick load time
- Thumb-friendly buttons

Design specifications:
- Clean, professional look
- Content preview prominent
- Clear value hierarchy
- Minimal distractions
- Trust signals visible

Form best practices:
- Fewer fields = more conversions
- Email only for maximum signups
- Progressive profiling later
- Clear privacy statement
- Strong action button
